checks.stdout:
usage: hccl_graph_manager_probe.py [-h] [--devices DEVICES] --model MODEL
                                   --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR [--timeout TIMEOUT]
                                   [--stage-bank] [--compute-pipeline]
                                   [--pipeline-hybrid {0,1}]
                                   [--graph-compute {0,1}]
                                   [--graph-hybrid {0,1}]
                                   [--attention-three {0,1}]
                                   [--ffn-recv {0,1}] [--ffn-cross {0,1}]

Bounded native manager/phase/cache component with controlled arithmetic. Uses
the real base CudaGraphManager factory, dispatch and replay plus NPUGraph HCCL
operations. No checkpoint, native model/attention, Engram, production Graph
selector or full-model microbatch threads participate.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --devices DEVICES     FFN then Attention NPU
  --model MODEL         configuration only; no weights
  --output-dir OUTPUT_DIR
  --timeout TIMEOUT
  --stage-bank          reuse the production tensor bank across layers
  --compute-pipeline    fork controlled arithmetic on the production C6
                        compute pipeline
  --pipeline-hybrid {0,1}
                        C6 stage-ready hybrid policy (default 1 with
                        --compute-pipeline)
  --graph-compute {0,1}
                        fixed session axis; supply all five axes together
  --graph-hybrid {0,1}  fixed session axis; supply all five axes together
  --attention-three {0,1}
                        fixed session axis; supply all five axes together
  --ffn-recv {0,1}      fixed session axis; supply all five axes together
  --ffn-cross {0,1}     fixed session axis; supply all five axes together
